planets.name: LP 890-9 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of LP 890-9 with a 8.46-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: LP 890-9 c was found in 2022 by SPECULOOS Southern Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around LP 890-9. Its orbit and size follow Delrez et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
